description: Check dorm bed-place availability and price for a date range at Aurinia XO (Kamianets-Podilskyi) — bed-places only, no room types. Read-only. check_out is optional (defaults to check_in + 1 night). Accepts an optional promo_code (e.g. BOT5), which yields the discounted price.

check_out.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Optional — defaults to check_in + 1 night.

guests.description: How many bed-places to check. One guest takes one bed-place; we sell places, not rooms. Default 1.

promo_code.description: Optional promo code, e.g. BOT5 for -5%.

name: get_availability
